body:
OPM 13%→25% over 7 qtrs on Almond Drops volume, price-point packs, coconut deflation (input relief, not premiumisation). Debt-free; −41% from high. Bull ~1.8x, bear −36%.
Kill criteria: OPM <19% 2 qtrs; Almond Drops volume <5%; any pledge; debtor days >40
Caveat: sourced from public screens — no proprietary edge (lesson L1). Pledges not confirmed from NSE SAST.
